retrievalProfile.description: A sharp, stoic central subject in casual brown attire surrounded by formal-clad figures rendered with intentional motion blur against a deep emerald interior.
excludeWhen: sharp focus on all subjects is required

recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast cinematic scene featuring a central male figure in sharp focus, seated in a tan leather armchair. He wears a brown t-shirt and cargo pants, contrasting with the surrounding group of men and women in formal black evening wear who are captured with horizontal motion blur. The setting is a rich emerald green room anchored by a large, ornate crystal chandelier and warm lamp lighting.
coreVisualRelationships: Sharp central subject vs. blurred peripheral subjects
Casual brown clothing vs. formal black attire
Warm leather and gold accents vs. cool emerald walls
Static seated pose vs. dynamic standing movement
coreInvariants: Central sharp focus on one person
Tan leather armchair as the primary seat

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central subject is seated, occupying the lower-middle third of the frame at a medium-full scale.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The tan leather armchair and the subject's direct gaze.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the sharp central face, moves upward to the chandelier, then circles through the blurred figures in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Limited; the frame is densely packed with figures and furniture to create a sense of a crowded room.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Emerald green (walls) providing a moody, saturated backdrop.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Tan/Brown (armchair and central clothing) providing a warm earthy counterpoint.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm white/Gold (chandelier light and jewelry) for highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the greens with deep shadows; high value highlights on the chandelier and skin reflections.

composition.relationshipToImage: contained within a white rectangular badge

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single-family condensed sans for utilitarian metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed, utilitarian feel of standard advisory labels.
Provides the necessary verticality and clean legibility.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of a man in a brown t-shirt sitting stoically in a tan leather armchair in an emerald green room. Surround him with people in black formal wear who are motion-blurred as if moving quickly. Include a large crystal chandelier overhead.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Place a small white rectangular badge in the bottom left corner containing black condensed sans-serif text stacked in three rows.

verificationChecks: Is the central figure sharp while others are blurred?
Is the wall color a deep emerald green?
Is the lighting warm and originating from the chandelier?
Is the text badge placed in the lower left corner?

adjustableVariables: Shade of green on the walls
mustRedesign: Avoid specific brand logos on clothing
Do not replicate specific faces of celebrities
Ensure the text content is generic metadata rather than specific trademarked phrases
postGenerationChecks: Check that the central subject's eyes are in sharp focus.
Verify the motion blur is horizontal and consistent across background figures.
Ensure the emerald green wall has subtle paneling or texture.
Confirm the chandelier light creates realistic highlights on the subjects.
recipe.reuseFormula: Central sharp subject + blurred formal crowd + emerald interior + leather anchor = Cinematic Social Contrast
